subject.title: Plugin approval gateway rejection reported to agent as misleading "gateway unavailable"

question: Which open fixing PR should be treated as the canonical landing path for the plugin approval rejection diagnostics bug?
rationale: The issue has multiple open closing PRs with different proof and mergeability states, so creating another repair job would add duplicate churn without maintainer selection.

options.title: Adopt proof-backed PR after conflict repair
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100231 as the preferred canonical fix if its conflict is resolved, because it has live-output proof and focused tests.

options.title: Use mergeable sibling after proof
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100228 active only if contributor adds real behavior proof or maintainers explicitly accept its proof gap.

options.title: Open a maintainer replacement
options.body: Create a narrow replacement only if maintainers do not want to carry any contributor branch as the final fix.

recommendation.title: Adopt proof-backed PR after conflict repair
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100231 as the preferred canonical fix if its conflict is resolved, because it has live-output proof and focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and merged the plugin approval surface and are the strongest history-backed owner for choosing the canonical fix path.
